_comment: Define your annotation scheme here. 'landmarks' is an ordered list of points the annotator places (in this order). Each entry needs: key (unique id, snake_case), label (shown in UI), color (hex), short (1-2 char badge). 'connections' is an OPTIONAL list of [keyA, keyB] pairs that draws a dashed guide line between two placed points (purely visual - no measurement is computed). To make your own scheme, edit this file only; no code changes are needed. The example below defines three generic points.
title: Image Annotation
subtitle: Navigate slices and place the configured landmark points on any slice.
